relations.text: 最大顧客のApplied Materials(子会社を含む)向け売上が、2025年と2024年は総売上の14%、2023年は12%だった
relations.text_en: Sales to its largest customer, Applied Materials and subsidiaries, were 14% of total sales in 2025 and 2024 and 12% in 2023

source.label: Benchmark Electronics 10-K
source.quote: Sales to our largest customer, Applied Materials, Inc. and subsidiaries, represented 14% of our total sales in both 2025 and 2024 and 12% of our total sales in 2023.

relations.text: Applied Materials(子会社を含む)は2025年と2024年の最大顧客で、いずれも総売上の14%だった
relations.text_en: Applied Materials and subsidiaries were the largest customer in 2025 and 2024, at 14% of total sales in both years

source.label: Benchmark Electronics 10-K
source.quote: Sales to Applied Materials, Inc. and subsidiaries, our largest customer in 2025 and 2024 represented 14% of our total sales in both 2025 and 2024.

relations.text: Ouster向けの大量生産を支えており、2022年の同社の製造パートナー・オブ・ザ・イヤーに選ばれた
relations.text_en: Benchmark was named Ouster's 2022 Supply and Manufacturing Partner of the Year and supports high volume production of Ouster sensors

source.label: Benchmark company ブログ
source.quote: we were very proud to be named the 2022 Supply and Manufacturing Partner of the Year for Ouster, a leading provider of high-resolution digital lidar sensors for the automotive, industrial, robotics, and smart infrastructure industries. Benchmark supports high volume production of Ouster sensors

relations.text: AEyeは次世代ライダー用の光学モジュールの製造先にBenchmarkを選んだ
relations.text_en: AEye selected Benchmark to manufacture the optical module for its next-gen adaptive lidar sensors

source.label: Benchmark company ブログ
source.quote: AEye announces it has selected Benchmark to manufacture the optical module for its next-gen adaptive lidar sensors.

companies.name: バンク・オブ・アメリカ

relations.text: 2025年6月27日に、Bank of America, N.A.を管理代理人とする7億ドルの第2次改定クレジット契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: On June 27, 2025, it entered into a $700 million second amended and restated credit agreement with Bank of America, N.A. as Administrative Agent

source.label: Benchmark Electronics 10-K
source.quote: On June 27, 2025, the Company entered into a $700 million second amended and restated credit agreement (the Credit Agreement) by and among the Company, certain of its subsidiaries, the lenders party thereto and Bank of America, N.A., as Administrative Agent, Swingline Lender and an L/C Issuer.
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

relations.text: 同契約には子会社が保証人として加わり、Bank of Americaが貸付人兼L/C発行銀行を務める
relations.text_en: Certain subsidiaries are guarantors, and Bank of America acts as Swingline Lender and L/C Issuer

source.label: Benchmark Electronics 10-K
source.quote: On June 27, 2025, the Company entered into a $ 700 million second amended and restated credit agreement (the Credit Agreement) by and among the Company, certain of its subsidiaries (the Guarantors), the lenders party thereto and Bank of America, N.A., as Administrative Agent, Swingline Lender and an L/C Issuer (Bank of America).
